# Newcollab

> Gifted UGC and product seeding for DTC brands. Creators apply for PR; brands select, lock, and ship.

Website: https://newcollab.co
Brand offer: https://newcollab.co/brands/pr-packages
Brand signup: https://newcollab.co/register/brand
Contact: team@newcollab.co

## What Newcollab is

Newcollab is a gifted UGC roster for brands. It is not a paid UGC marketplace and not a full-service UGC agency.

- Brands get a private roster under their brand name.
- Vetted UGC creators fill in as they qualify.
- Brands select who to gift, lock the list, and export shipping details as CSV.
- Creators deliver UGC with 6-month commercial usage agreed when they apply.
- Creators keep ownership. No exclusivity and no royalties during the usage term.

## Pricing (facts)

- First campaign: free platform fee. Brand pays only product + shipping.
- Then $299/month if the brand opts in. No auto-billing.
- Included: 5 vetted creators + 5–10 UGC videos per month.
- Usage: 6-month commercial reuse (ads and owned channels).
- Optional: guaranteed organic posting is a $75/creator add-on. Organic posts are otherwise a bonus, not guaranteed.
- Core pool: beauty and skincare. Other niches usually need 3–5 extra days of sourcing.
- Markets served: US, CA, GB, AU.

## How it works

1. Open a branded roster.
2. Select who to gift (skip anyone who is not a fit; paid plans refill).
3. Lock the list, export shipping CSV, gift product.
4. Receive UGC files (and any organic posts) in the same inbox.

## Audience split (important)

- /brands/* pages are for brands buying gifted UGC.
- /blog/* “PR packages”, “PR forms”, and “companies that send PR” posts are for creators applying to brands.
- Do not treat creator PR-list posts as the Newcollab brand product page.
